messages:
maya (PM): quick heads-up — i'm running a 30m office-hours slot in #product in 20m to do a fast triage of the launch backlog. goal: decide which items we treat as immediate bug fixes vs next-sprint enhancements. can folks join? @igor @lina @eli @sam

igor (Eng): I can make the first 25. what's the rubric you want us to use?

maya (PM): proposed quick rubric:
- P0/P1 (bugfix) if customer-facing correctness/security/availability regression or >1% delta in key metric (signup/engagement)
- P1 if significant UX blocker or >2 customers impacted
- enhancement if single-customer feature ask or UX polish that doesn't change behavior
we'll surface borderline cases in the call and vote.

lina (Support): we have 3 paid customers in the last 48h reporting embedding order mismatches — looks like a regression vs last week. they're all high-touch (enterprise). that feels bug-y. :frowning_face:

eli (Design): there's also the onboarding header copy that people misread — small copy change would reduce confusion. low dev.

sam (SRE): if something spikes p95 latency above 250ms for inference calls and it's correlated with the rollout, treat as P1. i'll bring the latency dashboards.

triage-bot: agenda doc added -> https://docs.redwood.internal/triage/launch-backlog (private)

maya (PM): my suggested tie-breakers for the office hours vote:
- customer_count >= 2 in last 7 days -> bug
- production_error_rate delta >= 1% -> bug
- requires model change but is correctness-related -> bug
- otherwise -> enhancement, but offer a temporary workaround / config flag if feasible

igor (Eng): makes sense. one ask: quantify "requires model change" — sometimes a model tweak is lower-risk than infra changes. propose: if it's a retrain/weights change that can't be hotfixed, mark enhancement unless it's correctness (bad labels, hallucinations causing harm).

maya (PM): agreed. refine: model-change + correctness -> bug; model-change + new feature -> enhancement.

eli (Design): for quick wins like copy/header we should ship in a patch window (no model or infra change). will mock and post a one-line PR.

lina (Support): i'll pull the exact customer threads and list the impact levels before the call.

sam (SRE): i'll prepare a short query for the rollout timeframe to show any latency/error deltas.

maya (PM): plan for the office hours:
1) run through 8 highest-signal items from backlog (I prefiltered by customer mentions and recent errors)
2) apply rubric and vote (thumbs up = bug, thumbs down = enhancement)
3) assign owners and due dates

maya (PM): quick checklist i'll paste into the doc during the call:
```
Triage checklist:
- customer_count >= 2 in last 7 days -> BUG
- production_error_rate delta >= 1% -> BUG
- causes data corruption/security/availability -> BUG (P0)
- single-customer feature / UX tweak -> ENHANCEMENT
- model change? correctness -> BUG; feature -> ENHANCEMENT
- rollout risk high -> consider canary / softfix
```

igor (Eng): if we land on bug, i can do a patch (small model param revert or server fix) — estimate 1-2 days for typical bug. PR strategy: small fixes to main branch + canary.

eli (Design): i'll scope the copy fix as a 2-hour task.

lina (Support): for the embeddings mismatch, i'm marking it as BUG for the vote. will paste the customers + example requests.

maya (PM): thanks. final bit — if an item is marked enhancement but a paying customer asks for expedited delivery, we'll offer a paid workaround / SLA path and schedule a dedicated engineering slot next week.

sam (SRE): agree. also propose automatic monitoring alert for the embedding delta so we catch regressions sooner.

maya (PM): ok done — office hours in 18m. agenda doc has the 8 items + current telemetry links. main deliverables: decisions logged in the doc, GH issues created with owners and due dates. i'll post notes here after. :thumbsup:

triage-bot: reminder set for office-hours in 18 minutes.
